605:t_107:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$シュロウガ$$... The time has come for our black wings to transcend causality.」

605:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, clad in hellfire, fate that stood still will tear through the Heavenly Prison!!」

605:t_108:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
($$アンナロッタ$$, $$ジェミニス$$... every life on the planet $$ジェミナイ$$... and the new life that was born, I swear it!)

605:t_108:1.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(Your regrets and your hopes for the future, I've taken them on myself!)

605:t_108:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I am $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$! A warrior of $$ジェミナイド$$!」

605:t_109:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I got to come back to this seat again...」

605:t_109:1.en:
$n
「The new suit and the glasses... they suit you.」

605:t_109:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Your smile has become decent enough, too.」

605:t_109:5.en:
$n
「I know! Now that Miss $$スズネ$$ and I are together, I'll draw out everything $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ has!」

605:t_109:6.en:
$n
「This is the power we fight with!」

605:t_110:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity is moving toward the future...」

605:t_110:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No matter who tries to stop it, we will overcome them...!」

605:t_111:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「The future $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ envisioned... the $$イノベイター$$s...」

605:t_111:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「If I am one, then I'll carve it out! The future humanity is meant to reach!」

605:t_112:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$... Your role as the key to $$ラプラスの箱$$ ended today...」

605:t_112:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But you and I aren't done fighting yet...!」

605:t_112:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, $$ユニコーン$$! We'll defeat whoever closes off possibility, and I'll make it back to $$オードリー$$ for sure!」
